items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: I remember when I got up there, George, George Foster, you know, he was playing bass. So he said to me, Pete, when we go back to New York, you're going to stay with me?

ctx.x: Yeah. How did you get that job up in Boston with Bishy?

Well, he sat down and asked me when I come, you know. I had my sister living in Mount Vernon, see. So I was working in insurance then, so I said well, I'll go up there and stay a little while, and see my sister, all at the same time and come back home, you see. I never intended to stay away, you understand, but I remember when I got up there, George, George Foster, you know, he was playing bass. So he said to me, Pete, when we go back to New York, you're going to stay with me? I said yeah. Man, I was thinking…
You play in one place at the time?
